question: What bodily form results from constant yogic practice over sixteen years?
premises: The practice is constant yogic discipline.
The duration specified is sixteen years.
A specific bodily form is said to result.
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi aṣṭa varṣa ākṛtiḥ is taken as the appearance of sixteen years
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
